subject: Physics
b6_reason: Bridge sensitivity is greatest when all four arms are comparable, so P and Q should be nearly equal, and small values give larger currents and hence larger galvanometer deflection.
b6_working: Balance condition X/Y = P/Q; sensitivity maximum for P ~ Q ~ X ~ Y and low resistance arms.
b6_note: Figure referenced in stem is not supplied, but the question is answerable from the standard Wheatstone bridge balance/sensitivity argument.
